claim.purpose: Add atomic typed terminal SOR artifact-reference repair and correct #5390

initial.title: [v0.91.7][csdlc-v2][closeout] Normalize SOR artifact refs during terminal reconciliation
initial.goal: Provide one fail-closed typed repair for stale SOR artifact references in a closed-out record.
initial.required_outcome: The typed operation atomically replaces #5390's deleted diagram reference with its byte-identical retained path and refreshes its terminal receipt.
declared_scope: csdlc-v2 terminal repair store and CLI
authority_boundary: Only exact stale-to-retained SOR artifact reference replacement is allowed
initial.task_boundary: Add and prove one atomic terminal SOR artifact-reference repair operation, then use it on #5390.
deliverables: Typed repair request and store operation
Corrected #5390 SOR artifact reference and receipt
acceptance_criteria: AC1: only exact existing SOR artifact references may be replaced
AC2: replacement must be a receipt-authenticated retained authored artifact with matching bytes
AC3: stale authority, target, artifact, or receipt identity fails closed
AC4: invalid phase, claim, path, duplicate, or no-op replacement fails closed
AC5: receipt refresh failure rolls target and receipt back
AC6: #5390 contains no generated reference to the deleted diagram path
AC7: focused tests, doctor, and exact review pass
dependencies: Typed C-SDLC v2 terminal repair transaction pattern
initial.plan_summary: Implement the narrow repair operation, prove fail-closed atomic behavior, repair #5390, review, publish, merge, and close out.

steps.action: Design and bind the terminal repair authority
Implement and test atomic terminal SOR artifact-reference repair
Review, publish, merge, and close out

risks: Overbroad terminal mutation would weaken immutability
Receipt refresh failure could split record truth
Path-only comparison could authenticate the wrong artifact bytes
invariants: Replacement path is receipt-authenticated and byte-matched
Receipt and target roll back together
stop_conditions: Exact review finds unresolved atomicity defects
review_prompts: Is the operation limited to exact SOR artifact-reference replacement?
Are path and byte identity both authenticated?
Can a failed refresh leave split truth?
Does #5390 contain any stale generated artifact reference after repair?

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove exact atomic repair and rollback
Prove #5390 terminal SOR and receipt parity
Prove bounded implementation and terminal truth

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on stale identity, missing authority, nonterminal target, invalid reference replacement, receipt mismatch, rollback failure, runtime changes, or unresolved review findings.
